import collections,json
from chay import ROOT,OUT,read,dump,sha
from cham import doi_thang
from m1_danh_gia.pha2 import giai_ma_json
folder=OUT/'runs/kiem-lai-phan-bien-002'
command=read(folder/'command.json')
for relative,digest in command['inputs'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT/relative)==digest,relative
t=giai_ma_json(read(OUT/'t4b.json'))
comparisons={}
for label,a,b in [
    ('E4+S1','R0-E4-S1-e0.05-a0.01','E1+E2-E4-S1'),
    ('z+S1','R0-z-S1','E1+E2-z-S1')]:
    comparisons[label]=doi_thang(t['scored'],a,b,t['E_X'])
for label,outcome in [('E4+S1','GIUP'),('z+S1','TRAI_CHIEU_DATASET')]:
    assert all(v['ket_cuc']==outcome and v['so_o_E_X']==23 and v['moc_gia'] is None
               for v in comparisons[label]['theo_the_gioi'].values())
scales={}
for dev in ('laptop','ec2'):
    path=OUT/'runs'/f'b2-t4b-{dev}-001/trung-gian.jsonl'
    with path.open(encoding='utf8') as f:
        for line in f:
            row=json.loads(line)
            if row['window']!='that':continue
            for base,data in row['bases'].items():
                key=row['opaque_id'],base
                assert key not in scales
                by_unit={u['unit']:u for u in data['z_distribution']}
                assert len(by_unit)==len(data['z_distribution'])
                scales[key]=by_unit
c=read(OUT/'co-che.json')
counts=collections.Counter()
rows=[]
for case in c['cases']:
    oid,base=case['opaque_id'],case['base']
    units=scales[oid,base]
    for flip in case['mechanism']['worlds']['P']['flips']:
        after=flip['after_relation']
        sides={}
        for side in ('root','rival'):
            maxima=[]
            for key in flip[side+'_z']['max_channels']:
                if key not in flip['channels']:continue
                unit=flip['channels'][key]['unit']
                u=units[unit]
                maxima.append(dict(channel=key,unit=unit,IQR=u['IQR'],c=u['c'],fallback=u['fallback']))
            sides[side]=maxima
        winner='root' if after<0 else 'rival' if after>0 else None
        winner_fallback=bool(winner and any(v['fallback'] for v in sides[winner]))
        counts.update(pairs=1,with_winner=winner is not None,ties_after=winner is None,
                      winner_with_fallback=winner_fallback,
                      either_side_with_fallback=any(v['fallback'] for side in sides.values() for v in side))
        rows.append(dict(opaque_id=oid,base=base,rival=flip['rival'],winner=winner,
                         winner_with_fallback=winner_fallback,PV_maxima=sides))
assert len(scales)==104 and counts['pairs']==81 and counts['winner_with_fallback']==0
assert len({(r['opaque_id'],r['base'],r['rival']) for r in rows})==81
result=dict(closed=True,comparisons=comparisons,PV_fallback=dict(world='P',counts=dict(counts),pairs=rows),
            inputs=command['inputs'])
print(dump(dict(outcomes={k:r['ket_hop'] for k,r in comparisons.items()},counts=dict(counts))))
(folder/'kiem.json').write_text(dump(result)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
